sentence: **Reviews are propagating unverified numbers.** The clearest case is a narrative review whose in-text citations are systematically misaligned with its reference list, and which quotes a 114,000× screening speed-up and a 0.063–0.076 eV RMSD without qualification [cited].

sentence: What is missing is a shared protocol for measuring whether a reward model's uncertainty is calibrated with respect to what the downstream policy actually needs — RoboReward's r = 0.83 correlation between reward accuracy and RL performance [cited] is a first step, but task-specific and short-horizon.

sentence: That same study introduced HumanEval-Java specifically to escape benchmark contamination, and its own leakage analysis is sobering — of 354 individual Codex fixes, 234 (66%) differed from the developer patch, and the authors concede that fully eliminating leakage would require retraining the models [cited].

sentence: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) interpolates between MHA and MQA, and its uptraining recipe (mean-pooling KV heads, then 5% of original pretraining compute) recovers near-MHA quality: GQA-8-XXL averages 47.1 quality at 0.28 s/sample against MHA-XXL's 47.2 at 1.51 s [cited].
ref: Joshua Ainslie, et al. GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints. Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, 2023. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2023.emnlp-main.298

sentence: SEAgent [cited] generalises to mandatory access control over a live information-flow graph, reporting 0% ASR on both InjecAgent and AgentDojo while matching naive-agent correctness — and, notably, demonstrating bypasses of IsolateGPT, CaMeL, and SecAlign under its privilege-escalation scenarios.
ref: Zimo Ji, et al. Taming various privilege escalation in LLM-based agent systems: A mandatory access control framework. ArXiv.org, 2026. https://doi.org/10.48550/arxiv.2601.11893

sentence: That survey is unusually blunt about the ordering, finding that early collaboration tends to be the empirical ceiling and late collaboration the floor on V2X benchmarks — on V2X-Sim, early collaboration reaches AP-BEV 64.2 against 55.4 for late fusion and 45.8 for no collaboration at all [cited].

sentence: Under robustness testing, seven neural repair systems failed on semantically equivalent rewritings of 20–35% of bugs, and only 58.8% of the transformations used in such tests were judged natural by human developers — meaning prior robustness claims may have over- or under-stated the problem by roughly a quarter [cited].
ref: T Le-Cong, et al. Towards reliable evaluation of neural program repair with natural robustness testing. 2025. https://doi.org/10.1145/3716167

sentence: ZR-0 supplies converging evidence from a different direction: it applies dense ECoT supervision over ~60M frames as an auxiliary language-modelling loss, then masks the chain out of the action expert's cross-attention so the trace is never generated at inference [cited].
